title: Inside ota/frontend
caption: HTML pages and partials hold the markup; one entry module per page runs `boot()` and mounts components; `lib/` holds the shared rules; the SDK is the only way to the API. Vite plugins make the dev and preview servers behave like Caddy, and two build scripts guard the output.

nodes.label: *.html pages
nodes.detail: `index.html`, `search.html`, `offer.html`, `price.html`, `checkout.html`, `checkout/*.html`, `confirmation.html`, `bookings.html`, `booking.html`, `lookup.html`, `account/*.html`, `p.html`, `404.html`.

nodes.label: partials/ + templates
nodes.detail: `header.html`, `footer.html`, `test-banner.html`, `states.html`, `noscript.html`, `search-form.html`, `templates/*.html` (`<template>` elements filled by `fill()`), included at build time by `<!-- @include … -->`.

nodes.label: src/pages/<page>.js
nodes.detail: One entry module per page; most export `start(context, env)` for tests.

nodes.label: src/boot.js
nodes.detail: Configuration, primary-host redirect, theme, header, footer, test banner, session, currency client; renders the shared page states (`renderState`).

nodes.label: src/components/*
nodes.detail: `search-form`, `location-combobox`, `filters`, `offer-card`, `fare-families`, `price-breakdown`, `stepper`, `traveller-form`, `contact-form`, `ancillary-picker`, `cancel-dialog`, `booking-timeline`, `dialog`, `live-region`, … each `mount(root, props)`.

nodes.label: lib/client.js
nodes.detail: The single SDK client (`/api`, cookie mode); drops the cached config on `403 TENANT_SUSPENDED`.

nodes.label: lib/config.js + config-cache.js
nodes.detail: `storefront.get` cached 5 minutes in `sessionStorage` under `vx.storefront.config`.

nodes.label: lib/session.js
nodes.detail: `auth.getSession`, account menu, `nextTarget`, password rules, auth page helpers.

nodes.label: lib/errors.js + i18n.js
nodes.detail: `pageStateFor(error)`: error code → page state; all English UI strings and plural rules.

nodes.label: lib/dom.js, forms.js, format.js, url.js
nodes.detail: Safe templating (`fill`, no `innerHTML`), field errors and error summary, money/dates via `Intl`, `safeNext`, query helpers.

nodes.label: lib/theme.js
nodes.detail: Branding → CSS custom properties, contrast checks, fonts, favicon.

nodes.label: lib/primary-host.js
nodes.detail: Sign-in / sign-up on the sub-domain → same path on the primary custom domain.

nodes.label: lib/blocks.js
nodes.detail: Content-page blocks → DOM with `createElement`; links and images re-checked.

nodes.label: lib/card-brand.js
nodes.detail: Airline-card page: brand from the BIN, Luhn, expiry, security-code length.

nodes.label: vite.config.js + scripts/vite-plugins.js
nodes.detail: MPA inputs, partials, Caddy-like routing, `/api` proxy, preview headers, isolated airline-card build.

nodes.label: scripts/payment-page-inventory.mjs
nodes.detail: Writes `dist/payment-page-inventory.json`; fails the build on an unreviewed page or third-party script.

nodes.label: scripts/check-budgets.mjs
nodes.detail: JS ≤ 60 KB gzip per page (airline card ≤ 30 KB), CSS ≤ 20 KB, HTML ≤ 20 KB, fonts ≤ 2 families / 120 KB.

nodes.label: @velexis/ota-sdk
nodes.detail: `ota/sdk/src`: namespaces `storefront`, `reference`, `flights`, `checkout`, `bookings`, `auth`, `account`.

nodes.label: deploy/caddy/Caddyfile
nodes.detail: Production routing and headers; `test/csp.test.js` and `test/pay-airline.test.js` compare the preview copies with it.

nodes.label: OTA API
nodes.detail: Same-origin `/api/v1/*`.
